description.en:
The region ID of the instance.
> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx describe-columnar-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
